predecessors.text: the east of Kamarupa: the infobox gives 'Predecessor: Kamarupa'

successors.name: Ahom kingdom
successors.text: the Chutia kingdom: Sadiya, Lakhimpur and the upper Brahmaputra (the Ahom dossier's region for the annexation)

ledger.x: 1228: the Chutia state stands round Sadiya as the Ahoms arrive.
1523: the war ends with the Chutia kingdom annexed.
1523: the Chutia kingdom is annexed by the Ahoms.

wars.name: Ahom-Chutia conflicts of the 14th century
wars.outcome: No territorial result: an Ahom king was killed in a 'friendly contact' with the Chutias in Sutuphaa's reign (1369-1379) and Tyaokhamti's expedition (1380-1387) 'returned with no success'.

wars.name: Ahom-Chutia war
wars.outcome: Ahom victory: Habung annexed in 1512, the Chutia attacks of 1513 and 1520 repelled, the Ahom fort at Dibrugarh in 1522, and 'the rest of the Chutia Kingdom' annexed in 1523-24.

certainty.note: No page gives a frontier; the extent follows rivers and hills (Burhi Dihing, Patkai, Bharali, the Himalayan foothills) and the Ahom dossier's discs.
